name: Impeccable for OpenClaw (unofficial)
description: Unofficial community port of Impeccable (impeccable.style): the frontend design skill with 24 commands, detector tools and a native anti-pattern design gate.

cliCommands.name: impeccable
cliCommands.description: Impeccable design skill: engine setup, project hook switch, detector

gate.description: The design gate runs the engine's hook after UI edits. It is on by default in every project, as in upstream; a project turns it off with `/impeccable hooks off`.

perEdit.description: Append detector findings to write/edit/apply_patch results for UI files (upstream PostToolUse).

onFinish.description: Run the deep pass before a run that edited files finishes, and request a revision on findings (upstream Stop). Conversation access is granted when you approve the plugin's capabilities.

maxRevisions.description: Extra model passes the deep pass may request per run. The embedded runner caps all plugins at three.

install.description: auto: when a regular Impeccable install (e.g. ~/.agents/skills/impeccable) is the copy OpenClaw serves, run that copy's own launcher so the skill text and engine version match. bundled: always run this plugin's copy.

trustProjectInstalls.description: Let the gate and tools run the launcher of a project-level install (<workspace>/.agents/skills/impeccable or <workspace>/skills/impeccable). Off by default: a project launcher is repository code.

engineBin.description: Absolute path to a preinstalled impeccable engine binary (sets IMPECCABLE_BIN). Leave unset to use the checksum-verified cache from `openclaw impeccable engine install`.

editTimeoutMs.description: Per-file budget for the per-edit pass.

stopTimeoutMs.description: Budget for the deep pass before finishing.
